mapper.select: SELECT scenario_category_no, p_scenario_category_no, name, sort_order, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_category ORDER BY COALESCE(p_scenario_category_no, 0), sort_order, scenario_category_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_category (p_scenario_category_no, name, sort_order, use_yn) VALUES (#{pScenarioCategoryNo}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_scenario_category SET p_scenario_category_no = #{pScenarioCategoryNo}, name = #{name}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_category_no = #{scenarioCategoryNo}
